name: Check-in and check-out
text: Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is until 11:00. Late check-out until 15:00 is available on request for USD 20.

name: Wi-Fi and breakfast
text: Free Wi-Fi in all rooms. Breakfast buffet is served 06:30-10:30 in the Lotus Restaurant and is included in the room rate.

name: Pool and gym
text: The rooftop pool and gym are open 06:00-21:00 and are free for guests.

name: Airport transfer
text: Airport transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport costs USD 35 per car. Please book 12 hours ahead.

name: Cancellation policy
text: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. After that, the first night is charged.

name: Lotus Restaurant (Sri Lankan buffet)
text: Hotel restaurant serving rice and curry, hoppers and seafood. Vegetarian options available.

name: Ministry of Crab
text: Famous crab restaurant in the Dutch Hospital, 10 minutes by car. Seafood only, not vegetarian.

name: Pettah Street Food Walk
text: Guided walk through Pettah market tasting street food. Good for vegetarians and budget travellers.

name: Gangaramaya Temple
text: Buddhist temple and museum, 15 minutes by car. Dress modestly.

name: Galle Face Green sunset walk
text: Free seafront promenade, 5 minutes from the hotel. Best at sunset.

name: Colombo National Museum
text: Sri Lanka's largest museum, good for history and culture lovers. Closed on public holidays.

name: Lotus Tower
text: Observation deck with city views. Best at dusk.

name: Galle Fort day trip
text: Full-day trip with car and guide to the UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, about 2 hours each way. Beach and shopping.

name: Serenity Spa
text: Ayurvedic massage and facials at the hotel spa. 60-minute massage costs USD 45.
